PP complete plus SI: Completed the primary package of interventions plus an additional secondary intervention/s b. PP Complete: Have completed the primary package but have not received any secondary intervention c. PP incomplete: Have completed at least one DREAMS intervention but have not yet completed the primary package 5) Violence Prevention/Education Subsidy: Displays the percent of AGYW who have received a violence prevention/education subsidy intervention during the FY 6) Refresh date: This is the date when the data being displayed was last refreshed/updated 7) This is a graphical presentation of the performance of the violence prevention and education subsidy interventions 8) Filters: while on layering achievements tab, you can turn on the following filters: a. Agency b. IP c. County, Sub-county, ward d. Age group e. Time in DREAMS f. Annual period g. Semi-annual period D. Layering Data Tables Tab: This tab provides data associated with the service layering visuals which can be exported in excel format. You can apply the filters in number 8 above while on this tab DREAMS Indicators In this section, we describe each of the DREAMS variables whose performance is monitored through the dashboards and the inclusion criteria for a service to be counted in the numerator. For all interventions, the achievement forms the numerator while annual target is the denominator. 1. Active Beneficiaries Definition This is a count of all unique AGYW who have received at-least one DREAMS service (any service) within the financial year. DREAMS Variables Considered Any DREAMS service Notes: • An AGYW is counted under this indicator if they have completed at least one DREAMS service. Age Group Targeted • 10-14,15-17,18-19,20-24 years 2. Condom Promotion Definition This is a count of all AGYW who received a condom promotion intervention within the financial year Services considered Condom Education and Demonstration, Sister to Sister-K Notes: • An AGYW is counted under this indicator if she has either received Condom Education and Demonstration OR Sister to Sister-K Age Group Targeted: • 15-17,18-19,20-24 years 3. Contraception IEC Definition This is a count of all AGYW who received Contraception IEC intervention within the financial year. DREAMS Variables Required Contraception Method Mix - Education/Info, Contraception Method Mix - Individual Counselling Notes: • An AGYW is counted under this indicator if she has either received Contraception Method Mix - Education/Info OR Contraception Method Mix - Individual Counselling Age Group Targeted: • 15-17,18-19,20-24 years 4. Combined Socio-Economic Approaches (CSEA) Definition This is a count of all AGYW who received a CSEA intervention within the financial year. DREAMS Variables Required Economic Strengthening - Business Startup Kit, Economic Strengthening – Employment, Economic Strengthening - Entrepreneurship Support, Economic Strengthening – Notes: • An AGYW will be counted under this indicator if she has received at least one of the listed services.
